mapIdentity.scope: Named OpenStreetMap palace relation with an exterior and courtyard ring, geotagged CC0 courtyard photograph, national heritage record, and measurements published by the HeritageCare palace survey team.

note: The independent survey records a four-wing structure around a rectangular courtyard with a two-storey portico and 39 brick chimneys. Current CC0 photos show ashlar, pointed gallery arches, the lighter stone columns above, the lower tile lean-tos and brick chimneys above steep roof slopes.
